title: Duckification
description: This turns different items into duck looking variants, it's straight up ducktastic!
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37a65377070d196bc65b0ece0e3941f7f4161e52.png)
![Devider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c29255922330a9e06e5466b2fa408a0c264060bf.png)
This turns different items into duck looking variants, it's straight up ducktastic!
![Devider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c29255922330a9e06e5466b2fa408a0c264060bf.png)
![Features Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df433b76e923b99a78e7f101edceb26ecf072665.webp)
This pack changes the following textures to a duck variant:
- Diamond sword
- Diamond axe
- Totem of undying
- Golden apple
- Heart
![Devider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c29255922330a9e06e5466b2fa408a0c264060bf.png)
![All Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67dc012e25147f8a604018ae56112a9db80004a9.png)
